label: harness-speed-baseline-2026-09-11
why: Frozen sample behind docs/harness-speed-optimization-plan.md. A 'latest 14 runs' query does NOT reproduce it: new runs have since shifted the window. Always select by taskId.
confounders: Two worker models are mixed: glm-5.2 (n=2222 usage records) and deepseek-v4-flash (n=180). Latency p50 7.5-8.0s for both, but p90 differs (32.1s vs 18.2s).
Task difficulty is not controlled. Output-token size correlates with both latency and task complexity; the causal direction is not established by this sample.
'A phase served by >1 worker' (14/42) counts spawns, not causes. Step-cap exhaustion, planned concurrency, failure re-dispatch and recovery are NOT separated here.
